header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: the worship of Allah, 3. One whose heart is attached to the masjid at all times, 4. Two persons who love each other only for the sake of Allah, meet for His sake and part for His sake, 5. One who, when a beautiful woman of high lineage invites him to herself, says, “I fear Allah', 6. One who gives charity in such a way that his left hand does not know of it, 7. One who remembers Allah in solitude and sheds tears.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَاجَلَسَ قَوْمٌ مَجْلِساً لَمْ يَذْكُرُوا اللهَ فِيهِ وََلَمْ يُصَلُّوا عَلي نَبِيِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانَ عَلَيْهِمْ تِرَةً فَإِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُمْ وَإِنْ شَاءَ غَفَرَ لَهُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ:هذاحديث حسن صحيح باب ماجاء في القوم يجلسون ولايذكرون الله رقم:٣٣٨٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “For those who sit in a gathering in which they do not do the Dhikr of Allah and do not send Salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ, that gathering will become the cause of great loss tomorrow on the Day of Qiyamah. If Allah wills He will punish them, or if He wills He will forgive them.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنْ رَسُولِ الله ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَنْ قَعَدَ مَقْعَدًا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللهَ فِيهِ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اللهِ تِرَةٌ وَّمَنِ اضْطَجَعَ مَضْجَعاً لَّا يَذْكُرُ اللهَ فِيهِ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اللهِ تِرَةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب كراهية ان يقوم الرجل من مجلسه ولايذكرالله رقم:٤٨٥٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever sits in a gathering and does not do the Dhikr of Allah in that gathering, that gathering will become the cause of loss for him. And for the one who sleeps without the Dhikr of Allah, that sleep will bring loss.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.
